name: 3z
description: A Threes-inspired sliding number puzzle. Merge 1s and 2s into 3s, then doubles, with score badges that fly onto tiles.
author: linuxbox
changelog: v1.6.9: Tap score screenshots to replay the endgame celebration. Best score gets full fireworks + NEW BEST; others get the soft burst. v1.6.8: badges settle with no snap.
